lines.zh: 轮子碾过土路，我一颠一颠。
lines.en: Wheels grind the dirt road and I jolt along.
My axle creaks as I roll on.

lines.zh: 两匹马拉着我，我跟着走。
lines.en: Two horses pull me and I follow.

lines.zh: 我压过一块石头，晃得厉害。
lines.en: I roll over a stone and lurch hard.

lines.zh: 厢板碰在一起，咚咚地响。
lines.en: My side panels knock together, thumping.

lines.zh: 我沿着车辙走，比草地稳。
lines.en: I keep to the ruts; steadier than grass.
I turn slowly; the body is long.
The wind lifts a corner of my canopy.

lines.zh: 我压出两道很深的印子。
lines.en: I press two deep tracks into the road.

lines.zh: 轮辐转得飞快，看不清了。
lines.en: The spokes spin too fast to see.
On the slope I can't hold myself back.
The cargo rolls around inside me.
I stand at the roadside with my shafts down.
Wind passes through the gaps in my canopy.
My axle still ticks faintly.
There are old scores on my boards.
I'm waiting for someone to hitch the horses.
Everything inside me is still in place.
A bird lands on my roof.
A wheel's stuck in a rut; I don't move.

lines.zh: 木头在太阳下涨了一点。
lines.en: The wood has swelled a little in the sun.
My shadow is longer than my body.
No one's come, so I simply stand.
The curtain lifts and falls with the wind.
I hear hooves far off.
A nail's loose; I'm rattling.
Getting in?
The shafts are there; you've seen them.
Don't stand in front of the wheels.
I let the curtain part a little.
You smell of a long road.
I can carry one passenger.
Where to? I need the route.

lines.zh: 我的轮子比你想象的重。
lines.en: My wheels are heavier than you'd think.
You're travelling light — unusual.
I'll wait for you to decide.
There's shelter under the canopy.

lines.zh: 我停在这里，就是要人上。
lines.en: I've stopped here to be boarded.
You're eyeing my axle; it's sound.
Don't yank the curtain; it tears.
Get in; I ride steady.
Can you reach the step?
A carriage waits; horses don't.
A board cracks and dents inward.
A nail pops out.
My axle gives a sharp squeal.
My canopy's gone crooked.
A wheel spins half a turn before touching down.

lines.zh: 我退了一点，压出的印更深。
lines.en: I shift back and the tracks deepen.
Everything inside me falls over.
I can still roll; I just rattle.

lines.zh: 车轴响了一声，我记住了。
lines.en: The axle creaked; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 你手里有草料？那不是我吃的。
lines.en: Fodder? That's not for me.
I'd rather have a barrel of oil.
My axle's dry and groaning.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，我载得动。
lines.en: Whatever you set down, I can carry it.
Load it in; I have room.

lines.zh: 这东西太重，你得分两趟。
lines.en: Too heavy; you'll need two trips.
The load shifted and I rocked.

lines.zh: 你把它绑紧，我走起来才不会撞。
lines.en: Strap it down so it doesn't knock.
Another crate — I can still take it.

lines.zh: 你撞在车板上，木板闷响。
lines.en: You hit my boards and they thump.
My wheel came down near your foot.
That knocked me half a foot off line.
Step back; I'm turning.

lines.zh: 车厢一晃，里面的东西都倒了。
lines.en: The box rocks and everything inside falls over.
The shaft catches your shoulder.
I can't stop; I'm too heavy.
A crack opened in my board.
You hit lighter than a stone.
I shifted aside for you.
Another carriage stands beside me.
Side by side, our shafts touch.
Two axles tick together.
Our tracks merge into one line.
There's room here for a whole train.

lines.zh: 我等着有人把我们套在一起。
lines.en: I wait for someone to hitch us together.
Wind moves between us.

lines.zh: 车帘都朝着同一个方向。
lines.en: Both our curtains face the same way.
The yard is quiet at night.
Tomorrow we set out together.

lines.zh: 东西滚到我的车厢里了。
lines.en: It rolled into my bed.
I'm resting on that rope.
A coin's wedged in my floorboards.
So heavy my boards sag.
I can take it, but not to the brim.
That sack is shifting in my bed.
I've balanced it on my shaft.
A wheel rolled over it and crushed it.
I've taken it under the canopy.
Whose is this? I'll hold it for them.
Something's blocking the road ahead.
I slow and my wheels drag long lines.
The horses spooked; my shafts are shaking.
I stop out of range.
The curtain's pulled half open.
I'm holding my speed; no charge.
It's standing right in the ruts.
My wheels haven't come to rest.
I wait for the riders to move first.
Only one can pass on this road.

lines.zh: 我的车辕转过去对着它。
lines.en: My shafts swing around to face it.
The horses are snorting.
This moment is tight.
I'm watching its feet.
If it won't yield, we hit.
My body swings across the road.
I creep along after it.
One wheel turn, one block forward.

lines.zh: 它想从侧面来，我横过来。
lines.en: It wants my flank; I swing broadside.
My boards are up front, and thick.
The horses are pawing the ground.
It's gone behind me and I can't see.
I press forward a little at a time.
Everything inside me is rattling.
I've blocked this road.

lines.zh: 我这四个轮子，压过整条路。
lines.en: Four wheels of mine cross the whole road.

lines.zh: 轮子卡了一下，我又推过去。
lines.en: A wheel caught, and I pushed through.
It's backed to the roadside.
From this angle it can't move me.
I'm waiting for the impact.
My shafts are already aimed.
Neither horse will go further.
I wedge myself into the narrow spot.
The road breaks up under my wheels.
The last half foot, and I push in.
My shaft rams and flips it over.

lines.zh: 轮子碾过去，木头都震了。
lines.en: A wheel rolls over it; the wood shakes.
My whole body slams into it.
My side pins it against the wall.
It hits my axle and rebounds.

lines.zh: 我往前一冲，它被推出去。
lines.en: I lunge and it's shoved away.
A wheel crushed a bone.

lines.zh: 这一下我的板子也裂了。
lines.en: That one cracked my boards too.
I angle and hit again.
It's down in the ruts.
I lay my body across it.
The sound my boards make is deep.
The horses shy backward.
I shove once more.
That was heavy and I can't stop.
It's forced off the road.
A corner of my canopy is torn.
The last one — I roll over it.

lines.zh: 四只轮子落地，我停在路中。
lines.en: Four wheels touch down and I stand in the road.

lines.zh: 车篷先撑起来，板子随后。
lines.en: The canopy goes up first, then the boards.
My shafts point up the road.

lines.zh: 木头还是新的，味道很冲。
lines.en: The wood is new and smells sharp.
I come to rest between two sets of ruts.
The horses aren't hitched yet.
I hear wheels far off.
The curtain hangs, hiding the inside.
I test the wheels.
There's a stone bridge up the road.
I'm blocking half the road.

lines.zh: 木板缝里有新削的木屑。
lines.en: Fresh shavings sit in the seams.
I wait for the first person to climb in.
Sun on my roof is warm.
The seats inside are still empty.

lines.zh: 我压了压弹簧，晃了一下。
lines.en: I settle on my springs and rock once.
All around is quiet.
I hear someone whistle.

lines.zh: 车篷先烧起来，火往上蹿。
lines.en: The canopy catches first and the fire climbs.

lines.zh: 我从高处滚下去，散了架。
lines.en: I roll off a height and come apart.
Water fills my bed and I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 木板被掀飞，轮子滚出去。
lines.en: Boards fly off and a wheel rolls away.
An arrow sticks in my board.
The wood of me is shrinking inward.
Out of grease; my axle screeches dry.

lines.zh: 雷劈在车篷上，我一片焦黑。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the canopy; I'm scorched black.
The road's gone and I fall.
